title: Correct Intensity Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct intensity distribution equation I = I_0 sin^2(N phi/2) / sin^2(phi/2).

title: Correct Number of Maxima
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the number of subsidiary maxima as N - 2.

title: Explanation of Intensities
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why the intensities of subsidiary maxima are not identical, referencing the behavior of the sine function.

title: Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define and use the variables d, N, and lambda in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of the intensity equation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expressions for intensity and number of maxima.
